subject: Post-demo recap + ask: monthly token profile & peak TPS for hosted pricing
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>

Subject: Post-demo recap + ask: monthly token profile & peak TPS for hosted pricing

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Great conversation and I think theres a clear fit for Redwood Hosted to power your conversational search layer. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can draft a tailored pricing proposal: 

Recap (short):
- Clipper.ai will use the Redwood hosted API for model-inference only; no fine-tuning or private deployment for POC.
- Primary workload: conversational search + short-form answer generation embedded in the product UI.
- Target go-live (internal pilot): Jan 2027.

Asks (what we need to price accurately):
1) Expected monthly active requests and expected average tokens per request (avg prompt + response). If you dont have exacts, a best-effort range is fine.
2) Peak TPS (concurrent token throughput) during busiest 10-minute window — approximate burst number.
3) Monthly budget range youre thinking about for hosted inference (ballpark is fine).

To help you, we attached a short template (clipper-estimates.xlsx) — two rows to fill: "typical session" (avg tokens) and "concurrency assumptions". If easier, reply inline with ranges and well convert to $/1M token targets.

Well put together two proposal options: (A) pure pay-as-you-go with volume bands, and (B) a 6-month reserved slab with slightly better $/1M and a TPS commit.

Thanks — will follow up in 24h if I dont hear back.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: clipper-demo-recording-20261003.mp4 (recording), clipper-estimates.xlsx (fill-able estimates)

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: monthly token profile & peak TPS for hosted pricing

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the quick recap and the template — appreciated. Devon and I filled in the spreadsheet and also included a short note here so you dont have to convert right away.

High-level (POC / pilot):
- Active users (monthly): 45k - 60k (we consider a user "active" if they query the search feature at least once in the month).
- Avg tokens per request: 180 - 260 (prompt+response). Our UI often asks for a ~100 token prompt and ~120 token generated answer.
- Estimated requests/month: 900k - 2.4M (depends on engagement scenarios we discussed).
- Peak TPS (10-minute busiest window): 180 - 320 TPS (this is requests/sec; if you prefer token-tps, multiply by avg tokens).
- Budget range for hosted inference pilot: $3k - $8k / month. Were flexible on mechanics (banded pricing vs reserved) — main ask is a predictable monthly bill in the pilot.

We attached the completed worksheet and also a short CSV showing 3 traffic scenarios (low/expected/high). Let us know if you want the raw analytics export.

Cheers,
Sophie
Head of Product
Clipper.ai

Attachments: clipper-estimates.xlsx (completed), clipper-traffic-scenarios.csv

Date: 2026-10-04T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: monthly token profile & peak TPS for hosted pricing

Great, thanks Sophie — this is exactly what we need. A few clarifying notes so the pricing math is aligned: 

1) Converting requests to tokens: using your ranges, we estimate 900k requests * 220 avg tokens = ~198M tokens/month (low) up to 2.4M * 220 = ~528M tokens/month (high). If youd like, we can recalc using the low/high avg tokens as well.
2) Peak token TPS: using your 180-320 request TPS range and avg 220 tokens/request, that maps to ~39.6k - 70.4k tokens/sec peak. That has bearing on instance sizing and burst allowances.
3) Pricing targets: you mentioned $3k-$8k/mo. To map to $/1M tokens, that implies a target of roughly $5.7 - $40 / 1M tokens depending on scenario (wide range). For a realistic pilot, to get both predictability and coverage for bursts, we typically aim for $6 - $12 / 1M tokens for a hosted pilot with modest commit.

Next steps (proposed):
- Ill draft two proposals: (A) pay-as-you-go with banded $/1M tiers and soft burst limits, (B) 3-month reserved slab (commit to tokens/month) with a TPS commit and lower $/1M.
- If you can confirm which traffic scenario (low/expected/high) youd like us to price to, well lock numbers and include a recommended TPS safety margin (we typically add 20% headroom for short bursts).

CCing Marissa and Karthik to help with the pricing bands and to get a proposed $/1M for both options.

Thanks — will attach a short PDF proposal after internal alignment.

Best,
Dylan

Dylan —

Quick confirmation from our infra team (Devon): the 180-320 TPS range was conservative; we now expect an expected peak closer to 220-260 TPS for the 10-minute window, with occasional micro-bursts to 340 TPS for <2 minutes. Usage skew: 70% of requests are short (<=150 tokens), 30% are long (>=300 tokens) during heavy guides.

If it helps the math, our expected pilot target (what wed pay for) is: 300M tokens/month (mid scenario) with a 20% headroom for bursts (so price and commit to 360M tokens). Budget target remains ~ $6k - $9k/mo.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
Sophie

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Clipper.ai pilot numbers + ask (pricing prep)

Internal note — do not forward yet.

Key inputs from customer:
- Pilot committed target (customer says): 300M tokens/month, wants 20% headroom -> price to 360M tokens.
- Peak request TPS: 220-260 req/s; micro-bursts to 340 req/s (<2m).
- Token mix: 70% short (110 tokens), 30% long (340 tokens) => overall avg ~ (0.7*110 + 0.3*340) = 179 tokens/request, but Sophie earlier reported 180-260. We'll price conservatively using their 220 tokens avg we used earlier to be safe.
- Budget: $6k - $9k / month target.

Quick pricing thinking:
- If we price pay-as-you-go at $9 / 1M tokens, 360M tokens -> $3,240/mo (below their lower bound). At $18 / 1M -> $6,480/mo (mid of their budget). To land in their stated band, we should aim for $16 - $20 / 1M for a no-commit banded PAYG, or offer a reserved 3-month slab at $8 - $10 / 1M with a TPS commit to accommodate bursts.

Recommendation for proposal:
1) Option A (PAYG banded): 0-200M @ $22 /1M, 200-500M @ $16 /1M. No TPS guarantees, soft burst policy. Estimated monthly: ~$5.76k at 360M (working math).
2) Option B (Reserved pilot - 3mo): Commit 360M tokens/month, TPS commit 400 req/s burst allowance (2m bursts). Price $9 /1M tokens => ~$3,240/mo. Offer a pilot SLA and priority scaling during bursts.

Action items:
- Marissa: draft the customer-facing PDF with both options and tidy numbers + a clear ROW (role of reserved slab for predictable billing).
- Karthik: evaluate infra cost and confirm whether a 400 req/s burst allowance with auto-burst policy is reasonable on our side; also verify that the $9 /1M reserved price is within margin for pilot.
- I will propose a 15-min call with Sophie+Devon tomorrow morning to align on Option B details if theyre open to a reserved pilot.

If we can get Option B accepted, we should push for a 3-month commit and a short-term credit to expedite contract sign.

Thanks,
Dylan
